observations.source_locator: PubMed abstract, Methods and Results; English abstract of German-language article.
limitations: The 18-39 week range describes the study cohort; the abstract does not provide age-stratified numeric values or endpoint-specific denominators.
The abstract states that linear regression against gestational age and a 95% confidence interval were calculated, but it exposes no coefficients, intercepts, fitted values or confidence-bound values.
The qualitative trend statements are source-reported summaries, not measured week-specific values. No age-specific number is derived or converted.
The abstract says pH, pO2 and pCO2 were measured, while oxygen saturation, bicarbonate and base excess were calculated; calculated endpoints are kept distinct from measured endpoints.
The study describes a human in-utero reference cohort. It does not measure ex-utero support, machine performance, healthy development under artificial support, or a sufficient safety envelope.
The PubMed English abstract is pinned. The article is in German, the Karger full-text route was inaccessible in this environment, and reuse rights are unconfirmed.
